llm.summary: This skill uses sensitive relationship context to suggest and draft outreach, but its behavior is disclosed, draft-only, and aligned with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The requested context can include private social and communication data, but the instructions limit use to available user context, require evidence labels, and separate work from personal context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown, JSON, and CSV examples/templates only; no executable installer, dependency, remote payload retrieval, or tool wrapping was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may use calendar, email, messaging, shared tabs, contact notes, and language signals when the user makes them available, which is broad but disclosed and tied to relationship outreach.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill says there is no storage beyond the session unless configured, does not request elevated privileges, and does not create background tasks or automatic sending behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe detecting outreach opportunities, ranking them, and preparing multilingual drafts; they repeatedly state that the skill does not send messages.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable letting the agent analyze relationship context you provide or connect, such as calendars, messages, contact notes, and shared social pages. Review every draft carefully, especially inferred language, cultural or religious occasions, and personal details, before sending anything yourself.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: Language detection from communication history appears throughout the skill and examples; this is sensitive, but it is part of the disclosed multilingual drafting purpose and drafts still require user review before use.
[SQP-2] expected: The examples aggregate contact notes, calendar events, conversation history, and social-tab signals; this is privacy-sensitive but matches the stated relationship-digest function and is bounded by least-privilege and evidence-boundary instructions.
[EA3] expected: Support for any language is not supported by artifact evidence as unrelated scope creep; it is coherent with the skill's stated multilingual outreach purpose.
